text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! With another<n>year behind
me, I feel like I've peeled<n>off my old self and
emerged as an<n>even more disciplined class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of the new and<n>improved me?
Don't you have a<n>saying prepared for me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Y-you want one of my<n>sayings?! Um... let's
see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about this? "Grapes are<n>easier to peel
once you boil them!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh?! So you're comparing me to a<n>grape! Looks
like my eye for literary<n>talent is 20/20! Naturally, as
I don't<n>need glasses!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Boiling must refer to the hard work<n>I've put in! And
since grapes grow in<n>clusters...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then you must be trying to say that if<n>you put in the
work to peel off your<n>old self, then your efforts will
surely<n>bear many fruits!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is a saying that truly fits me like<n>a glove! Thank
you for the wonderful<n>present!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (It's more of a cooking tip than a<n>saying, though...)
